g.text: The expensive context burns in the subagents. The main thread is where you keep your mental model, so it only gets short reports back.
MAIN THREAD · YOU AND YOUR MENTAL MODEL
list what you could NOT verify
down: one brief with its own rules · up: a short report, what it did, what broke, what it could not verify
Prompt, 13-08: "todo esto usando subagentes, asi no ocupamos el agente principal".
Anything that burns tokens without producing a decision goes to a subagent.
MDs are savepoints for Claude, you will rarely read them.
Artifacts are for humans. Do not make your team talk to your chatbot.
